title: On Shutting the shop for the whole winter
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：shut　|　正文 371 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shut 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the coach ① shut the shop for the whole winter without a word of thanks, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the coach ② shuts the shop for the whole winter at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ shut the shop for the whole winter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ shut the shop for the whole winter before — a line in the record for April 1968 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Shutting the shop for the whole winter without a word of thanks, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ shut the book in the middle of a line at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Shut the book in the middle of a line at once and never mention it again.

By 1981 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new player from the next field ⑧ shuts the book in the middle of a line without a word of thanks every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stand, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ shut the shop for the whole winter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To shut the shop for the whole winter, my mother said in 1986, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody shuts the shop for the whole winter at once again and somebody must shut the shop for the whole winter without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 关上（一般过去式 shut the shop for the whole winter：1974 年教练头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 关上（一般现在 shuts the shop for the whole winter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 关上（不定式 to shut the shop for the whole winter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 关上（过去完成时 had shut the shop for the whole winter：1968 年四月的赛事记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 关上（动名词 shutting the shop for the whole winter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 合拢（shut the book in the middle of a line：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去合拢看到半行就把书合上）
G. v. 合拢（shut the book in the middle of a line：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 关上（后段两处：新来的队员照例 shuts the book in the middle of a line，而母亲又一次 shut the shop for the whole winter）

answers.why: shut 意为“关上”，1974 年教练不图一句谢关上把铺子关了整整一冬，那是球场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 shut。
shut 意为“关上”，自那以后教练二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 shuts。
shut 意为“关上”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯关上把铺子关了整整一冬”，此处为不定式 to shut the shop for the whole winter。
shut 意为“关上”，赛事记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1981 年之前就有人关上过，故用过去完成时 had shut。
shut 意为“关上”，教练说“关上把铺子关了整整一冬这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 shutting the shop for the whole winter 作主语。
shut 意为“合拢”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去合拢看到半行就把书合上”，should ever 之后用原形 shut the book in the middle of a line。
shut 意为“合拢”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻合拢看到半行就把书合上（shut the book in the middle of a line at once），以后再也不要提起。
shut 意为“关上”，新来的队员每个赛季都照例合拢看到半行就把书合上，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 shuts。
shut 意为“关上”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢关上把铺子关了整整一冬，用一般过去式 shut 叙述。
shut 意为“关上”，结尾那句是母亲 1986 年的话：要关上把铺子关了整整一冬，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和球场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 shut 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the coach shut the shop for the whole winter without a word of thanks, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the coach shuts the shop for the whole winter at once whenever the field asks.
Shutting the shop for the whole winter without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever shut the book in the middle of a line at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new player from the next field shuts the book in the middle of a line without a word of thanks every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother shut the shop for the whole winter again, and the field remembered that half.
